scenes: one point five billion dollars. Gone from Bybit in a single February day.
Hackers compromised a supplier and altered the digital wallet address during the transfer.
Around four hundred one thousand Ethereum tokens poured straight into attacker wallets instantly.
By February twenty-sixth, twenty twenty-five, the F B I pinned it on North Korea's LAZ-uh-rus Group.
And then it got stranger. Dubai-based Bybit actually sued a foreign nation-state in court.
But out of one point five billion, only forty-eight point four million dollar came back to the exchange.
Another thirty point five million dollar remains frozen across twenty-eight exchanges and custodians pending further legal action.
Proving even a one point five billion dollar cyber heist leaves traces.
